reviews_captured_by_me.text: I hired Robert to clad walls of a terribly ugly basement entry room and he did an amazing job in less than ideal conditions. The room turned out to be a beautiful addition to my home! It may become a mud room now, transformed from an awful catch-all storage area. Thank you Robert! I am beyond happy with the results! Before and after photos are attached.

reviews_captured_by_me.text: I had an amazing experience with Robert’s Repair when they assembled my dresser! Robert was professional, punctual, and very detail-oriented. He put everything together quickly and made sure it was sturdy and perfectly aligned. You can tell he takes pride in his work. The whole process was smooth and stress-free, and the dresser looks great. I highly recommend Robert’s Repair for anyone needing furniture assembly done right!
